status: Exploratory follow-up; choices frozen before these runs, after prior exploratory findings
questions: Does the manuscript signal survive joint length/pool control?
Do named historical passages or copiers reproduce the same full-versus-above-only pattern?
Which geometry, cohort, section, direction, source definition and null restrictions constrain it?
primary: Full selector, all guaranteed-valid bifolium-interior targets; bifolium x exact transcription length 2..9 x pool-count tertiles; cells >=25; boundary values in lower band; cell-size weighted low-minus-high quintile contrast.
secondary: Full selector on interior A and B
Above-only on interior A and B
Full selector with five pool-count bands
Full selector exact pool-count within-cell residual correlation, cells >=2
Clipped-length/min20/pooled sensitivity statistic on full all, full A, above A and above B (fixed guaranteed-valid cohort)
Cursor-like target-left-edge sensitivity on a common full/cursor cohort
Within-line x length null (999 draws), manuscript and original Rhazes passage
Past/future repeat outcomes and bifolium/section contributions for primary full selector
interior_A: Not first/last on assigned line; full selector pool count >=15
interior_B: Not first/last on assigned line; above-only pool count >=15
null: Permute word identities within original paragraph x exact transcription length; retain every slot length, fixed boxes, memberships, weights, target cohort, pool cuts and cells. Use the same geometry for observation and null. For synthetic layouts validate fixed geometry against re-typesetting same-length substitutions.
validity: Guarantee >=5 pair-bearing sources and pair ESS>=3 under every allowed paragraph permutation. Conservative minimum pair-bearing mass squared / all weight squares bound.
direction: One-sided positive excess; (1 + exceedances)/(B+1). Report MC tail intervals; no early stopping based on p.
multiplicity: Holm for four primary manuscript tests (2 measures x 2 geometries); separate Holm families for full-selector historical contrasts and above-only historical contrasts. Secondary/specification checks are exploratory.
limits: Same data are reused; no new independent manuscript replication
Absence of significance does not establish equivalence or absence
Finite historical controls cannot establish uniqueness among all languages or processes
Copying controls require their own null baseline
No claim to explain irregular wave geometry without a specific shape statistic
numerical_policy: Round all score values to 10 decimal places before ranking or residualization, for observations and every null draw. Preserve ties. Validate full aggregates independently with NumPy for observation and first/last permutation.
